image_description: A close-up, high-resolution portrait of a green iguana's head and upper neck. The image focuses on the textured scales, the large golden eye with a round pupil, the prominent white subtympanic shield, and the beginning of the dorsal crest spines along the nape. The background is a soft, out-of-focus bokeh of yellow and green hues.
